URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-air-strikes-injure-two-ukraines-kyiv-odesa-officials-say-2026-10-01/
Reuters — published 1 October 2026, 04:18 UTC (05:18 BST)

Russian air strikes have injured one person in Ukrainian capital Kyiv and another person in the Black Sea port city of Odesa, Ukrainian emergency service and an Odesa city official said on the Telegram messaging app on Thursday.
Infrastructure was damaged in Odesa, which Russia attacks frequently as it tries to prevent Ukraine from earning export revenue, Serhiy Lysak, the head of the city's administration, said on Telegram, without providing details.

THIS IS THE ONLY APPROVED-OUTLET CONFIRMATION OF THE OVERNIGHT-INTO-1-OCTOBER STRIKES THAT I COULD FIND.
The Ukrainian Air Force's own overnight figures — 107 attack drones launched from 18:00 on 30 September, 63 of them jet-powered, 87 shot down or suppressed as of 08:00, hits at 11 locations, debris at 4 locations, attack still ongoing at the time of the report — are carried ONLY by non-approved outlets in my sweep: en.interfax.com.ua (Interfax-Ukraine), unn.ua, pravda.com.ua, censor.net, mezha.net, ua.news, prm.ua, aa.com.tr (Anadolu), eaworldview.com. Anadolu (aa.com.tr, 2026-10-01T06:55:50Z) also reports Ukraine's State Emergency Service said there were impacts in Kyiv, Odesa and Sumy with no deaths or injuries, and that Russia's defence ministry claimed its air defences destroyed 330 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones.
